Class InitState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.states.State
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am49.server.model.states.InitState
public class InitState extends State
Represents the initial state of the game, where setup and configuration are performed. Allows administrative actions such as selecting the game mode and creating the game, as well as enabling players to join the lobby. Illegal operations trigger exceptions, ensuring state-specific behavior is maintained.
